unit.why: The division is a run of homilies and interpretations of verses, Talmud and Mishnah passages, with no narrative of its own: a Purim question-and-answer session framed as 'פעם אחת הי׳ בדיחא דעתיה בפורים', and a one-line illustrative mention of a holy man spilling oil out of rapture inside a teaching on Aaron.
unit.boundary_note: Opening sentences ('וזהו כוונת ר״י שאמר כמה נפיש האי גברא...') conclude the explanation in the story of the previous division (the maggid and the opened 'channel'); the rest is independent teachings.
